step_by_step_reasoning: The whiteboard visualizes an architecture for verifying vaccine passes/credentials. The user traffic originates from 'USERS' passing 'CREDENTIAL' data into an Elastic Load Balancer (ELB). ELB connects directly to WAF for security checks, Shield Advanced for DDoS protection, and EKS for core microservice execution. Terraform and AutoScaling are drawn as standalone architectural components/tools supporting deployment and scaling. All node services and edge flows follow visual directional arrows on the board.
